description: Recorded non-release exceptions for scripts/check-release-hygiene.mjs. scope=local applies to local/ci runs only; release mode ignores every waiver and fails closed. Expired waivers no longer cover violations. Each entry is release debt with an owner-reviewable reason and expiry.

waivers.subject: maildev/maildev:latest
waivers.reason: Local SMTP sink for the development stack; not a production dependency. Pin a release tag/digest before an industrial release.

waivers.subject: mcr.microsoft.com/azure-storage/azurite
waivers.reason: Azurite is the development object-store emulator; production storage must use a real service. Pin the MCR image tag for reproducible local stacks.

waivers.subject: host-path:C:\Program Files\Docker\Docker\resources\bin
waivers.reason: Docker Desktop PATH bootstrap for the external quickstart. Not used by release artifact builds; release CI uses the standard PATH.

waivers.subject: weak-default:HUB_DATABASE_PASSWORD
waivers.reason: Development-stack fallback when .env is missing; generate-env.ps1 always supplies a random value. Release mode requires a secret-management decision.

waivers.subject: well-known:storage-account-key
waivers.reason: Azurite emulator well-known account key; production object storage must inject a real key/secret. Local-only default.

waivers.subject: well-known:storage-account-key
waivers.reason: The dev .env generator seeds the Azurite emulator key; real deployments overwrite it via the secret store. Local-only default.
